capabilities: play ambient TTRPG music tracks in the background
control playback using note front matter
disambiguation: Not a general audio recorder or podcast player; it plays ambient music tracks driven by note front matter for TTRPG sessions.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; there is no README, so setup and usage details are unknown.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to play ambient background music during tabletop role-playing game sessions from notes.
summary: Background audio player that plays ambient TTRPG music tracks based on note front matter.
